outcome_sought: Remove the late fees and interest charged while he was in hospital, and stop the collections calls.
rationale: Collections calls, letters and two late fees continued while the customer was in hospital, and the partner who told us had no authority, so CP-9.1, CP-9.2 and CP-1.2 all apply and Financial Support owns it. The call note records the illness, his income drop and his preference for email, and the cards log shows the balance, arrears and the new hold, but there is no income and expenditure, no forbearance history and no debt advice signposting.
